tasks.title: Programming Assignment 1
tasks.description: Students implement three C++ tasks about course prerequisite graphs: the lowest-difficulty study path, the number of courses made unreachable, and a course ordering number.

subtasks.label: Task A
subtasks.description: Find the lowest total difficulty of a study path that makes course s eligible.

subtasks.label: Task B
subtasks.description: Count courses that become unreachable when course s cannot be passed.

subtasks.label: Task C
subtasks.description: Find the ordering number of course s in a tie-broken topological order.

tasks.title: Written Assignment 3
tasks.description: A written assignment on trees, binary search trees, AVL trees, bitonic search and a robust QuickSort.

subtasks.label: Question 1
subtasks.description: Trees: missing child count, reconstruction, traversals and leftmost-child/right-sibling representation.

subtasks.label: Question 2
subtasks.description: Binary search tree and AVL tree operations, deletions, insertions and rotations.

subtasks.label: Question 3
subtasks.description: Find the peak of a bitonic array and search it in O(log n) time.

subtasks.label: Question 4
subtasks.description: Analyse QuickSort and design RobustQuickSort with a worst-case O(n log n) bound.
